content:
The Apple store at The Oracle in Reading, UK, will relocate to a new address in December with a brand new design.

Before that, the Apple Festival Place store in Basingstoke will close in November, bringing the number of Apple retail stores in the UK down to 38...

Apple says the revamped Oracle store will offer all the amenities customers have come to expect from its newest store designs.

We look forward to reopening the completely redesigned Apple The Oracle store in December, giving customers in the South East of England a new way to discover and shop the latest Apple products, and get support for the devices they own. The new Apple The Oracle will feature an Experience Room for customers to explore the products, a dedicated Genius Bar and an Apple Pick Up area for collecting online orders, as well as free Today at Apple sessions teaching customers how to get the most out of their favourite products.

The store originally opened in June 2011. The Basingstoke branch will close before the reopening.

While preparing for these updates, we decided to close the Apple Festival Place store. Apple Festival Place will remain open until November 2026, after which all employees will have the opportunity to transition to roles at Apple The Oracle or other Apple Store locations. We have been proud to serve the Basingstoke community for the past 15 years and look forward to continuing to welcome customers at nearby Apple Stores, as well as through Apple.com, the Apple Store app and Apple Authorised Resellers and Service Providers in the South East of England.

That store has also been operating since 2011.

Over the past 18 months, Apple has refurbished its Regent Street store in London and its branch at Lakeside shopping centre in Essex. Stores in Birmingham and Southampton are also undergoing upgrades.

Globally, Apple has opened 11 new stores over the past 18 months, and relocated another 17 to new sites with fresh designs, including Apple Miami Worldcenter and Apple Downtown Detroit.
